electricityContract.terms: This plan is only available to residential customers in NSW. Your supply address must have a compatible smart meter. A reasonable usage charge will apply for usage in excess of 24kWh during the free period. For terms see alintaenergy.com.au/termsandconditions or call 13 37 02.
electricityContract.variation: Alinta Energy's market tariff and feed in tariffs (where applicable) may be varied in accordance with applicable laws. If we change the applicable tariff, we will give you notice of any variations in accordance with applicable laws.

incentives.description: This plan includes a 3-hour free usage period all year round in local time from 11am to 2pm in NSW. Times will not vary with daylight savings. If you use more than 24kWh per day during the free usage period, additional usage will be charged at the applicable rate.

electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: We reserve the right to and will notify you if we change or impose additional fees or charges in relation to your energy supply.
